```{r load-data, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load the SMARVUS dataset
data_file <- "smarvus_complete_050524.csv"

# Download dataset only if it is not already saved
if (!file.exists(data_file)) {
  smarvus_raw <- read_csv("https://osf.io/download/a4zmv/")
  write_csv(smarvus_raw, data_file)
} else {
  smarvus_raw <- read_csv(data_file)
}
```

RMARS is revised mathematics anxiety rating scale (NORMAL MATHS ANXIETY ONE) Q8.2_1 to Q8.2_24
RMARS-S is like RMARS but replaces the maths with stats Q7.2_1 to Q7.2_23
STARS is statistics anxiety rating scale (NORMAL STATS ANXIETY ONE) Q7.1_1 to Q7.1_23
STARS-M is a modified version of STARS but replaces the stats with maths Q8.1_1 to Q8.1_20

```{r}
    grade = if_else(
      grade %in% c(
        "Not Available", "-",
        "No stats module on record", "No stats modules",
        "Non complete - LoA", "No access to transcript")
      NA_character_, grade)
```

###### Option B: Complete-Case Scoring *(Group: delete Option before submission)*

Under this stricter rule, a participant only receives a score on a scale if they answered every item on that scale, and only participants with complete responses across all four scales are retained.


```{r score-option-b, include=FALSE}
# Compute mean scores ONLY when 100% of items are answered (0 missing)
smarvus_scores_complete_all <- smarvus_clean %>%
  mutate(
    stars_n   = rowSums(!is.na(select(., Q7.1_1:Q7.1_23))),
    rmars_s_n = rowSums(!is.na(select(., Q7.2_1:Q7.2_23))),
    stars_m_n = rowSums(!is.na(select(., Q8.1_1:Q8.1_20))),
    rmars_n   = rowSums(!is.na(select(., Q8.2_1:Q8.2_24))),

    stars_mean   = if_else(stars_n   == 23, rowMeans(select(., Q7.1_1:Q7.1_23)), NA_real_),
    rmars_s_mean = if_else(rmars_s_n == 23, rowMeans(select(., Q7.2_1:Q7.2_23)), NA_real_),
    stars_m_mean = if_else(stars_m_n == 20, rowMeans(select(., Q8.1_1:Q8.1_20)), NA_real_),
    rmars_mean   = if_else(rmars_n   == 24, rowMeans(select(., Q8.2_1:Q8.2_24)), NA_real_)
  )

desc_option_2 <- smarvus_scores_complete_all %>%
  select(stars_mean, rmars_s_mean, stars_m_mean, rmars_mean) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Scale", values_to = "Score") %>%
  mutate(
    Scale = recode(
      Scale,
      stars_mean   = "STARS",
      rmars_s_mean = "RMARS-S)",
      stars_m_mean = "STARS-M",
      rmars_mean   = "RMARS"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(Scale) %>%
  summarise(
    Valid_N     = sum(!is.na(Score)),
    Missing_N   = sum(is.na(Score)),
    Missing_Pct = round(mean(is.na(Score)) * 100, 1),
    Mean        = round(mean(Score, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    SD          = round(sd(Score, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Min         = round(min(Score, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    Max         = round(max(Score, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

smarvus_scored_complete <- smarvus_scores_complete_all %>%
  filter(!is.na(stars_mean), !is.na(rmars_s_mean), !is.na(stars_m_mean), !is.na(rmars_mean))

n_scored_complete   <- nrow(smarvus_scored_complete)
n_excluded_complete <- n_clean - n_scored_complete


```

Requiring complete responses across all four scales excludes 130 participants, leaving 1412 for analysis.


```{r desc-table-option-b, echo=FALSE}
knitr::kable(
  desc_option_2,
  col.names = c("Scale", "Valid (N)", "Missing (N)", "Missing (%)", "Mean", "SD", "Min", "Max"),
  caption = "Descriptive statistics for the four anxiety scales under strict complete-case scoring (evaluated on N = 1,542)."
)
```
